source.title: Constructed exercise (not from a publication): toluene cooled by toluene in a counter-current exchanger, patterned on the FOSSEE and DWSIM exchanger exercises
source.use: specification written for this repo; the structure follows the tutorial
source.note: every input is my choice, flagged assumed. It exists to run an organic liquid through the exchanger path; FOSSEE Exp 10 uses styrene, which CoolProp does not have, so it has no independent oracle

basis.enthalpy_reference: not used; outlet temperatures follow from an enthalpy balance

params.assumed: all values chosen by me: U 800 W/m2K x 5 m2 = 4000 W/K, drops 20 kPa each side

reported.name: hot_outlet_T
reported.anchor: independent: UA-mode solution with CoolProp Toluene enthalpies (energy balances and Q = UA x LMTD, counter-current), computed 2026-11-21; hot outlet temperature

reported.name: cold_outlet_T
reported.anchor: independent: UA-mode solution with CoolProp Toluene enthalpies (energy balances and Q = UA x LMTD, counter-current), computed 2026-11-21; cold outlet temperature

reported.name: hot_side_duty
reported.anchor: independent: UA-mode solution with CoolProp Toluene enthalpies (energy balances and Q = UA x LMTD, counter-current), computed 2026-11-21; heat removed from the hot side, 256.9226 kW (negative: the hot stream loses enthalpy)

reported.name: hot_outlet_P
reported.anchor: independent: UA-mode solution with CoolProp Toluene enthalpies (energy balances and Q = UA x LMTD, counter-current), computed 2026-11-21; inlet pressure minus the hot-side pressure drop

reported.name: cold_outlet_P
reported.anchor: independent: UA-mode solution with CoolProp Toluene enthalpies (energy balances and Q = UA x LMTD, counter-current), computed 2026-11-21; inlet pressure minus the cold-side pressure drop

tolerance.note: temperatures 2 percent (of the value in C) and the duty 3 percent, fixed before the run; the paper package is itself an assumption (a cubic equation of state is the usual choice for hydrocarbons), so a miss is a finding about the package, not about the case

review.method: independent UA-mode solution with CoolProp toluene
